_doc: Verified same-word (base form, entry id) pairs for build/check_link_baseform.py. A pair belongs here ONLY when the link's base form and the declared entry are the SAME WORD under a different spelling or a kana headword, so the link takes the reader to the right word and the disagreement is an indexing artifact. Never add a pair to silence a link that points at a different word — repair the link instead. Every pair below was verified in context during the link-target-baseform-disagreement sweep (batches 1-7, 2026-07-31..2026-08-06); see planning/wiki/ideas/cleanup-backlog.md and the session logs for the per-family reasoning.

_classes.variant-spelling: One word, two written forms (or a kana headword). Nothing to fix; the entry is the correct destination.
_classes.near-duplicate-pair: Both spellings exist as SEPARATE entries, so either target is defensible and the disagreement can never be driven to zero by link repair. These are consolidate_entries.md work, tracked as the entry-pair-consolidation backlog item; when a pair is merged, delete its line here.
